biggest_catch: The friend must complete a demanding qualification: within 60 days, either 12 debit card purchases on a new checking account, a new credit card, or a new loan.
catches: You and your friend each earn $100 per qualifying referral.
Up to $500 every year in referral incentives.
Friend must not have been a Verity member in the past two years and must be at least 18.

Friend qualification within 60 days: enroll in Digital Banking and sign in, plus open a checking account with 12+ debit card purchases, open a new Verity credit card, or open a new Verity loan (excludes first mortgages).
Rewards are deposited within 14 days after qualifications are met.
Cannot be combined with any other incentive offer.
Bonuses are considered interest and may be reported on IRS Form 1099-INT.
Membership: Washington State residents or immediate family of members.
$100 offer effective 6/15/25 and subject to change at any time.
Separate business referral: $100 to the referrer when a referred business opens a Verity Business Checking account (use promo code BUS100).

steps: Add your referral's contact info (name and phone number) in the Refer a Friend section of Digital Banking.
Friend joins Verity (no membership in the past two years).
Friend enrolls in Digital Banking and within 60 days completes a qualifying action (12 debit purchases on a new checking account, a new credit card, or a new loan).
You and your friend each receive $100 within 14 days (up to $500/year).
timing: $100 deposited within 14 days after qualifications are met.
